verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a SaaS equity-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no public API at all, and all OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404. The llms.txt file only describes the product for LLMs and is not a programmatic interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
